verdict.rationale: Convex is a backend/database, not a natural-language interface itself, but it does expose an MCP server so AI agents (which take natural-language instructions) can interact with a Convex deployment, and docs mention agents can scaffold apps by 'asking' them to create a Convex app. There's no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface for the product itself (e.g., a chat-driven admin/CLI); the NL-command capability is mediated entirely through third-party coding agents connecting via MCP. missing for 10: first-party natural-language command interface, evidence of direct NL control (not just agent-mediated), independent/hands-on validation of NL workflows.
